controls.label: Monochrome
controls.qualification: LROC WAC global morphologic mosaic v1.3, 32 pixels/degree, mapped to the 1,737.4 km lunar reference sphere.
controls.notes: LROC WAC 643 nm photography, mapped from observations in 2009–2011. Crater shadows are part of the photographs; the Shadows control adds scene lighting. Gray grid marks missing data. Brightness is adjusted for display.

controls.label: Midnight temperature
controls.qualification: False-color bolometric temperature fitted to local midnight from Diviner observations in 2009–2022. Colors span 80–140 K, with endpoint colors beyond that range. Gray grid marks missing data and latitudes beyond ±70°. This combines many nights; it is not a current temperature map.
controls.notes: False-color bolometric temperature fitted to local midnight from Diviner observations in 2009–2022. Colors span 80–140 K, with endpoint colors beyond that range. Gray grid marks missing data and latitudes beyond ±70°. This combines many nights; it is not a current temperature map.

controls.label: Heat anomalies
controls.qualification: False-color difference between Diviner bolometric temperature at slope-adjusted midnight and a model of typical lunar soil. Blue is cooler and red warmer than the model; colors span −10 to +10 K. Observations cover 2009–2022 within ±70°; gray grid marks unavailable data. Residual terrain effects remain, and warm colors do not establish geothermal activity.
controls.notes: False-color difference between Diviner bolometric temperature at slope-adjusted midnight and a model of typical lunar soil. Blue is cooler and red warmer than the model; colors span −10 to +10 K. Observations cover 2009–2022 within ±70°; gray grid marks unavailable data. Residual terrain effects remain, and warm colors do not establish geothermal activity.

controls.label: Rock abundance
controls.qualification: Surface area covered by rocks, inferred with a rock-and-soil thermal model from Diviner observations in 2009–2022 at slope-adjusted midnight. Colors span 0–2%; larger fractions share the brightest color. Gray grid marks missing or physically invalid values and latitudes beyond ±70°. This estimates rock area, not individual boulder counts.
controls.notes: Surface area covered by rocks, inferred with a rock-and-soil thermal model from Diviner observations in 2009–2022 at slope-adjusted midnight. Colors span 0–2%; larger fractions share the brightest color. Gray grid marks missing or physically invalid values and latitudes beyond ±70°. This estimates rock area, not individual boulder counts.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.qualification: LRO LOLA LDEM16 numeric elevation above a 1,737.4 km sphere
controls.notes: Numeric LOLA elevation above a 1,737.4 km reference sphere. Colors represent −12 to +12 km; this gridded laser-altimetry product includes interpolation and does not displace the globe or represent current illumination.

controls.label: Crust
controls.qualification: NASA GRAIL crustal-thickness map with shaded relief
controls.notes: Crustal thickness inferred from GRAIL gravity and lunar topography under assumed crust and mantle densities. This is an interior model shown with shaded relief, not a direct observation of the crust.

controls.label: Silicate signature
controls.qualification: Diviner Christiansen-feature wavelength with improved viewing-geometry and space-weathering corrections; composition proxy within ±70° latitude
controls.notes: Diviner measures a thermal-infrared emissivity peak related to silicate composition. This 2021 map corrects viewing geometry and space weathering. Colors span 8.0–8.5 µm; values outside that range share endpoint colors. This is a composition proxy, not mineral abundance; residual topographic effects remain, especially above 50° latitude. Gray grid marks missing observations and latitudes beyond ±70°.
